500.summary: Technology & Infrastructure · Models & LLMs Google Brings Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search in Its Biggest Model Upgrade Yet By James Dargan · 16 November 2026 · 1 min read Google is rolling out its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to Search globally, describing it as the biggest model improvement to Search so far.
500.body: Technology & Infrastructure · Models & LLMs Google Brings Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Search in Its Biggest Model Upgrade Yet By James Dargan · 16 November 2026 · 1 min read Google is rolling out its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to Search globally, describing it as the biggest model improvement to Search so far. While Google’s frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, focus on deep reasoning for hard problems, Hydrogen is built for fast execution across agentic workflows. Google said it completes tasks 2.5 times faster than its previous fast model, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and outperforms Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default thinking level. 600.title: Polish football fans clash with Romanian police after 2-1 defeat
600.summary: All the citizens have since been released, while 89 received fines A total of 105 Polish football fans were detained following clashes with Romanian police after Poland’s match against Romania in Bucharest on Saturday. Polish Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maciej Wewiór told Poland’s state-owned news agency, PAP, on Sunday that all 105 Polish citizens had been released, adding that 89 Polish nationals had received fines.
600.body: All the citizens have since been released, while 89 received fines A total of 105 Polish football fans were detained following clashes with Romanian police after Poland’s match against Romania in Bucharest on Saturday. The situation escalated when some Polish fans allegedly used a fire extinguisher and threw metal barriers at officers. Police then used tear gas to restore order before taking the 105 people to police stations for questioning. Polish Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maciej Wewiór told Poland’s state-owned news agency, PAP, on Sunday that all 105 Polish citizens had been released, adding that 89 Polish nationals had received fines.
